Brakujące pola/operacje: `map.attrs.unique=3099`.
Dowód różnicy zachowania: All1208 native map regions have no matching attribute. BundleFacts::push clones the sector attrs and quest_callback_matches requires the original unique/action. A position or appearance is not substituted.
